# sofascore_scraper.store.Follow
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/follows.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Follow:
    id: int
    kind: str
    entity_id: int
    name: str
    sport: Optional[str]
    seasons: Union[str, Tuple[int, ...]]
    slices: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]
    live: bool
    enabled: bool
    origin: str
    position: int
    created_at: int
    updated_at: int
    def spec(self) -> FollowSpec
